data.gender_notes: Minhaz is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Minhaz is derived from the Persian word 'minj' which means 'jewel' or 'treasure'. In Hindu culture, it is believed that this name brings wealth and prosperity. The name Minhaz carries the meaning “Jewel, Treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Minhaz usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
